positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Leaflet · Blazor · C# · Geographic Information Systems (GIS)

positions.title: Lead Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Led development and modernization of core SAROPS components supporting U.S. Coast Guard search and rescue operations. Architected and built Blazor WASM front-end components and .NET WebAPI services for operational forecasting, geospatial visualization, and mission planning. Designed and implemented Leaflet based visualizations, integrating GIS layers and environmental overlays and developed custom Leaflet plugins to extend platform capabilities. Served as rotating Scrum Master and provided technical leadership to the development team, driving adoption of modern practices and ensuring project continuity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained a SaaS practice-management system using ASP.NET WebForms, classic ASP, and ASP.NET MVC for healthcare clients. Built and supported internal applications with COM DLLs, console apps, MSMQ, Windows services, and web services. Managed Subversion source control and deployment pipelines to QA and production environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed full product life cycles for ASP.NET WebForms applications focused on quality and risk management. Designed SQL Server databases, stored procedures, triggers, and functions to support complex business rules. Developed SSRS reporting solutions and customer-facing data integrations.
